uddhambhāgiyasayojanasamugghāta: [Uddhambha] (ti) CL=7 [Giyasaṃyojana+samagghāta] It can be rejected and killed the Uddhambhāgiya attachment.
uddhareyyu: [U+dhara+a+eyyuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They should be pulled out. See - Uddharati - (A).
uddharissa: [U+dhara+ssaṃ] (kri) CL=7 It will pull out, It will rescue. See - Uddharati - (A).
uddharitu: [U+dhara+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 (A) To take out. (B) To take and rescue. (C) To remove. (D) To lift.
uddharisu: [U+dhara+uuṃ] (kri) CL=7 It has been withdrawn. See - Uddharati (D).
uddharāpesu: [U+dhara+ṇāpe+uṃ] (kā,kri) CL=7 They have been withdrawn. See - Uddharāpeti - (B).
uddhatapasu: [Uddhata+paṃsu] (pu,na) CL=7 It has dirt that should be removed.
uddhagamana: [Uddhaṃ+gamana] (na) CL=7 It climbs up (or) It goes upper (place)
uddhagamanāraha: [Uddhaṃgamana+araha] (ti) CL=7 It is worth to go upper realm.
uddhajāla: [Uddhaṃ+jāla] (na) CL=7 The upper net, A net that is bound in the upper reaches of a river.
uddhakhitta: [Uddhaṃ+khitta] (ti) CL=7 It shoots upwards, It shoots rising up.
uddhakoṭika: [Uddhaṃ+koṭi+ka] (ti) CL=7 It has a sharp tip that faces to upwards.
uddhamukhachidda: [Uddhaṃ+chidda] (na) CL=7 A hole that the mouth faces upwards.
uddhamukhapāda: [Uddhaṃmukha+pāda] (ti) CL=7 One whose legs are erected and faces upwards.
uddhamūla: [Uddhaṃ+mūla] (ti) CL=7 It has a raised root (or) It has a root that faces upwards.
uddhamūlaka: [Uddhaṃmūla+ka] (ti) CL=7 It has a raised root (or) It has a root that faces upwards. It is in reverse order (upper part and below part).
uddhapāda: [Uddhaṃ+pāda] (ti) CL=7 One whose feet face upwards.
uddhapādaadhosīsa: [Uddhaṃpāda+adhosīsa] (ti) CL=7 One whose legs face skywards and the head is below and reverse position.
uddhasara: [Uddhaṃ+sara+a] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who considers and speaks about (it is purity and liberation by Saṃsarā) in upper future Saṃsarā. (2) The doctrine that believes in the purity of saṃsāra.
uddhasaranta: [Uddhaṃ+sara+anta] (ti) CL=7 One who considers the Saṃsarā doctrine that is also future, One who desires the future Saṃsarā.
uddhasarāvāda: [Uddhaṃsara+vāda] (ti) CL=7 One who considers and speaks about liberation) by Saṃsarā.
uddhasate: [U+dhaṃsu+a+te] (kri) CL=7 It rises (or) flies. See - Uddhaṃsati.
uddhasota: [Uddhaṃ+sota] (pu) CL=7 Flowing upstream. Uddhaṃsota(ti) [(1)uddhaṃ+vāhī+sota.(2)uddhaṃ+gantvā+paṭilabhitabba+sota] It has a flow to stream. (A) It has the flow of craving and the flow of suffering cyclic that can bring the upper Suddhāvāsa realm. (It will be rebirth-linking again in the upper Suddhāvāsa realm after he is dead in the Suddhāvāsa realm due to the flow of carving that is attached to the body and the flow of suffering cyclic that is not cessation). (B) If you go and reach the upper Suddhāvāsa realm, will get the flow of Arahattamagga, (If you reach the first Suddhāvāsa realm, you will not get Arahattamagga yet, after you die in that realm, you will reach the upper Suddhāvāsa realm, at this life you will attain  Arahattamagga and become Arahant and attain Nibbāna (cessation of strife)). See Below.
uddhasotaakaniṭṭhagāmī: [Uddhaṃsota+akaniṭṭhagāmī] (ti) CL=9 A non-returner who is named Uddhaṃsota Akaniṭṭhagāmī. See original.
uddhasotavajja: [Uddhaṃsota+vajja]  CL=7 The Uddhaṃsota Akaniṭṭhagāmī Anāgāmī person, who flows upstream (uddhaṃsota) toward the highest realm (Akaniṭṭha) as a non-returner (Anāgāmī), is to be avoided (vajja), except when referring to another Uddhaṃsota Akaniṭṭhagāmī Anāgāmī person.
uddhavaṇṭa: [Uddhaṃ+vaṇṭa] (ti) CL=7 It has a stalk that is the upper place.
uddhavirecana: [Uddhaṃ+virecana] (na) CL=7 (1) It feels nauseated, The skill one can be felt nauseated, which can be vomiting the flaw and anger that are Phlegm, Bile, and Wind. See original.
uddhavāhita: [Uddhaṃ+vāhita] (ti) CL=7 It can bring the upper realm.
uddhavāhī: [Uddhaṃ+vaha+ṇī] (ti) CL=7 It can bring the upper realm.
uddhaṭhita: [Uddhaṃ+ṭhita] (ti) CL=7 It establishes in upper (place or realm). See - Uddhaṃṭhitaloma.
uddhaṭhitaloma: [Uddhaṃ+loma] (ti) CL=7 One who has goose- flesh and his body hairs tips face upwards.
uddhaṭapasu: [Uddhaṭa+paṃsu] (pu,na) CL=7 The fine soil that should be taken out.
uddhātu: [U+dhā+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 To take out and rescue.
uddisisu: [U+disa(disī)+uṃ] (kri) CL=7 They have been recited. See - Uddisati.
uddissakatamasa: [Uddissakata+maṃsa] (na) CL=7 Meal made on purpose (or) (It kills a living being) to get meal that is for someone.
uddissakatamasaparibhoga: [Uddissakatamaṃsa+paribhoga] (pu) CL=7 It makes aim for (or) makes on purpose.
udikkhisa: [U+ikkha+ssaṃ] (kri) CL=7 [Bhavissantissaṃ]. I have looking at it. See - Udikkhati-(1-A).
udikkhisu: [U+ikkha+uuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They have looked at it. See - Udakkhati-(1-A).
udāharitu: [U+ā+hara+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 To bring up or utter or recite.
udānasavaṇṇanā: [Udāna+saṃvaṇṇanā] (thī) CL=7 The phrase that explains the Joyful utterance Pāḷi. Udāna commentary.
